component.name: Linux Soundboard
component.summary: Native Linux soundboard with virtual microphone support

description.p: A high-performance, native Linux soundboard built with Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita. Play sounds directly into your microphone stream for Discord, OBS, Zoom, and any other application.

ul.li: Virtual microphone that seamlessly mixes your voice with soundboard audio
LUFS normalization for consistent volume levels
Global hotkeys (native XInput2 on X11 and XWayland, swhkd on Wayland)
Modern GTK4/Libadwaita UI with dark mode support
Organized sound library with tabs, a browsable folder hierarchy, and folder sync
Drag and drop support for easy sound import
Native PipeWire virtual microphone routing

description.p: Sound library and folder navigation update:

ul.li: Stores the sound library in SQLite and migrates existing configurations
Shows the complete folder hierarchy in the sidebar
Removes, restores, reorders, and combines sidebar folders
Cancels the folder scan started by Add Folder
Cuts startup and wide-library latency and memory

description.p: Ogg Opus and auto-gain reliability update:

ul.li: Adds mono and stereo Ogg Opus playback, seeking, duration, and LUFS normalization
Uses Dynamic auto-gain by default for new configurations
Shows live Analyze and Refine status counts
Fixes empty folder tabs, stream endings, and loudness analysis recovery

description.p: Safe upgrade and microphone lifecycle correction:

ul.li: Restarts stale installed audio engines and verifies the running app version
Restores a safe default microphone after temporary AppImage or development runs
Creates an exact private backup before migrating schema-6 configuration
Requires explicit approval before an AppImage installs a persistent service

description.p: Folder workflow and audio reliability update:

ul.li: Added folder-derived tabs and Delete-key removal
Fixed mixed-version engine startup and Ogg Vorbis playback
Hardened folder refresh, removal, and configuration persistence
Rebuilt swhkd from upstream source when packaged builds require pkexec
Improved swhkd startup diagnostics and recovery guidance
Fixed a hotkey capture dialog panic after backend startup failures

description.p: Major update promoted from the testing branch:

ul.li: Added atomic replace playback to remove stop/play snapshot races
Fixed continue play mode and stop-on-close behavior
Improved headphone mute icon states and small-size icon rendering
Updated swhkd hotkey formatting for native Wayland hotkeys

description.p: Patch release for packaging and release metadata consistency:

ul.li: Added third-party license notices and README acknowledgments
Refreshed release package metadata and install examples
Kept native Wayland and X11 support documentation aligned with shipped artifacts
Native Wayland support with X11 fallback
Distribution-specific packages (DEB, RPM, Flatpak)
Improved AppImage compatibility
Better virtual microphone creation on modern distributions
